subject: IW-0801
content:

Watching TV is an activity that can make you relieve your stress after school, but if you are addictive to watching TV, it will do harm for your eyes. Another reason is studying "too hard." Studying is nothing bad, but if you study all day and don't let your eyes take a break, then they will be tired and it will lead to nearsightedness.
How can we get away from nearsightedness? The easiest way is let your eyes get enough rest. After using your eyes, you can see green trees, take some eyes exercise, or even take a nap to relax your eyes. That could be helpful to protect your eyes and get away from nearsightedness.

subject: IW-0801
content:
Now with the advanced technology, children can easily play a lot of electronic games such as Xbox, PS4, or even the recent star, Wii. Children are always addicted to those products once they touch it, and someone even plays them day and night without a rest. As a result, the nearsightedness problems finally hit Taiwan; unfortunately, these problems have not only brought us to the top five country which possess the highest nearsighted ratio, but also decreased the age of having nearsightedness.
Today, nearly every student from elementary school to senior high have such problems. The only way to solve the problem is through their parents. Parents are an effective part to their children. All they have to do is keep their son or daughter from playing video games; for example, make a schedule for their children that tells them when to play, when to stop, and of course, when to study.
Another part to prevent nearsightedness is within themselves. Although their parents do make a personal schedule for them, they won't be able to follow it if they don't have much self-control. The possible way I recommand is that children can give themselves a reward everytime when they successfully stop playing and start to study.

content: More and more elementary school students in Taiwan become nearsightedness. There are two major reasons for this phenomenon. Second, due to the advencement in modern technology, more and more fun on-line games are sold in the market. They are often attracted by them because these games are very exciting and full of joys. On account of the two reasons mentioned above, they are easily become nearsighted. There three practical measures we can take to solve this problem. Third, eat as many as vegetables and fruit as possible because they are good for your eyes. By taking these measures thoroughly, I believe that nearsightedness can be prevented.

First, the children in Taiwan tend to watch TV in a short distance. Second, they tend to watch TV over one or two hours. Third, because the TV is more interesting than the mother nature, they prefer to be a couch potato than to get close to the forests and flowers. So, because of the overexposure to the radiation, their windows of the soul became worse and worse.
So, we should take precautions to avoid nearsightedness. First, parents should keep an eye on the gestures and surroundings when their children read or watch TV. Third, sometimes elementary school students are weighed down with a lot of assignments. They have no choice but to accomplish it. To my opinion, the best way to prevent students' nearsightedness is that we have to bring our elementary school students to near the great nature. Nearsightedness
Nowadays, almost every elementary school student is nearsighted. You can see that many students have glasses. Studying too hard might cause nearsightedness, but watching TV or playing computer games too much is the actual reason.
Students play computer games because they want to relax their mind, but actually, they aren't relaxing their eyes. While you're playing computer games, the muscles of your eyes are working to let you see the tiny words on the monitor. Long-time using computers can let you become nearsighted and cannot see things far away from you.
To prevent nearsightedness, we should cut down on using computers. If you have to study, study thirty minutes, and relax ten minutes. In the ten minutes, you can close your eyes or watch green trees. These tips might help you avoid nearsightedness!

The second promblem is the "school study"; In Taiwan, study at school is all of the kids must to do, the preasure of study makes children must study harder. and didn't take a rest.

subject: IW-0801
content: According to the reports, the rates of elementary school students have nearsightedness are more and more high in recently years.Lack of outside exercises and use computer for long time are two main factories in my opinion. After school or at home, most students play TV games and computer games all day, so that they get nearsightedness. I suggest that parents of the students can help them far from the computer.

subject: IW-0803
content: In Taiwan, we can try many different countries' food. My favorite kind of food is Korean food. The most special thing is "Kimchi". It's a kind of vegetable cooking. It tastes very spizy, but I like it very much. The first time I tried it was about two years ago. When I put it into my mouth, I felt so surprised. How delicious it is! From then on, I love this food, this country and this culture. Though I am just 15 years old, I hope I can go to Korea in the near future.

subject: IW-0803
content: There are all kinds of delicious foods in the world. Not only in Taiwan, but also in other countries. I love two kinds of foods. One is raw fish which is in Japan and the other is pizza which is in Italy. In my opinion, I think Japanese raw fish is the most delicious food in the world. I love it because I don't like the fish which has cooked, I think that kind of fish looked terrible and tasted terrible! I would rather eat raw fish. They looked better! The reason which I like Italian pizza is that there are a lot of vegetables on this kind of pizza, such as potatoes, tomatos and onions. Besides, this kind of food often add lots of cheese. I love cheese! However, these food are not good to my health. When I eat too much, my stomach ach a lot!

subject: IW-0803
content: In Taiwan, we can eat many kinds of dishes which are from many different countries. As far as I am concerned, I like to eat Taiwan dishes, such as noodles, rice, fire vegetables... and so on. Because I was born in Taiwan, I love Taiwan. The most important of all, Taiwan dishes are very delicious. For example, I like eating Tainan noodles, Jushan bamboo, and Taiching sun cakes. They are famous around Taiwan, and delicious. Take bamboo dishes for example. They can be eaten without fire, just with saurce, like salad. When I eat bamboo dishes, I feel I like a bearcat, it is sweat. To sum up, there are many kinds of dishes around the world, and maybe they are delicious, too. If I have a chance, I will try it. But at present, I love the Taiwan dishes the most.

subject: IW-0803
content: When it comes to susi, I will be very excited. That is --- susi is my favorite food which is from Japan.Susi is often been seen in Taiwan, such as restaurants, supermarkets, and even night markets. It shows that susi has played an important role in our life.Susi is convenient. It can be your breakfast, lunch, and dinner. Although you don't eat too much, you will not be hungry anymore. Besides, there are many different kinds of meats, vagetables, and so on in it.Susi is really delicious, and the most important one to me is - not too expensive.

subject: IW-0803
content: Japanes food is my favorite, especially, the food called shu shi. When many kinds of shu shi are put together in the dish, the colors of them are beautiful. And, the rules about eating in Japanes restaurant is also interesting to me. There are some special things in the Japanes restaurants. I always had different feelings when I entered the Japanes restaurants.

subject: IW-0803
content: If you ask me what kinds of food do I like to eat. I will say "America food". Don't you think they are delicious that there are cheeses in food?I like to eat cheese. Although it has a strange smell, but it is delicious. I like to eat fried chicken, potato, cheese and cola. I eat Mcdonload twice a week. I really like to eat America food.By the way, Taiwanese food are also delicious. Rice, noodles and dumplings are our main food. My mom always cooks by herself. They are delicious. I cannot help but tell you that Taiwanese food are the most dilicious.

subject: IW-0803
content: My favorite foregine food is hamburger. It is delicious and you can see it every where. I like hamberger because it is cheap than some foods, like fried chicken and pizza, but it taste better than them. Besides it is easily to find and convenince to bring. So I like it the most. However it is not good for health and it will make me fat. so It is not health to eat it very often.

subject: IW-0803
content: Eating delicous food is a wonderful thing for me to do. I love eating different kinds of food, taste all the food and enjoy it. Every time I eat, I feel so comfortable without any worries and just let my self steep in the amazement of the food. The foreign food I like the most is Italian food. There are pizzas, spaghetti, etc. And the pizza tastes so great, it smells so good that every time I see it, I can't wait to eat it. One of the reason why I love pizza is that there are so many flavors, you can choose your favorite. I think my favorite flavor is shrimps. Every time I ete them, it's just like I'm flying in the sky or even in the heaven, I won't feel tired or stressed anymore. Besides, Italian food always reminds me of my wonderful trip with my family to Italy, I like it a lot, and I'll still love it in the future. Try it yourself right now! Maybe you'll get addict to it and be crazy about it just like me.

subject: IW-0803
content: Yesterday was my birthday. I had a date with my best friend to go to a new restaurant. According to my classmates said, the dishes of the restaurant are good. Therefore, my best friend and I decided to choose there to celebrate my birthday. As soon as I stepped into the restaurant, I was enchanted by the upset. There has a stream surround the whole building, and some trees cover it. I thought it was comfortable and riched in nouth-easted. I ordered the scrambled-rice, cooked by a stone bowl. Before the meal arrived, I had a strong sense of curiosity about my food. After a while, my dish finally came. It smelt great, and was delicious. On the other hand, the preserved vegetables, providing free there very met my taste. I can not forget the spicy and sour flavors. I promised I will go to the restaurant in the next time.

subject: IW-0803
content: Like the golden sunset fading down to the pure white rice, it's juice shines like the sliver in my plate. What food with such a magical smell, looks, and tastes that makes me fall in? The answer is - Indian Curry. In India, curry is one of the main dishes on the table. The reason is that India rains a lot, hence, the spice of curry can makes them feel more comfortable in such a bad weather. There is a story about curry, too. Shira, the godness of destroy and dance, controls the buildings things. So every years the Indian must gave her some goods to please her for buildings safety. And one year they gave Shira the curry. After Shira eating the curry, she became more kindness and told the Indian they will get the protect by her forever. I like curry's spicy taste. It not only gains the dishes taste, smell, but looks. And to sum up, the magic of the curry that makes people happy is the very reason I like India Curry.

subject: IW-0803
content: Nowadays, we can eat many kinds of food from different countries. Some people like the steaks. Others prefer the pumpkin soup. My favorite foreign food is the apple pie. Once, my parents left me at home when I was a kid. To my surprise, my aunt came to visit me as I was hungry to die. Knowing I was hungry, she started to make apple pies for me. It tasted so sweet that I loved it so much. A little piece of apple dropped out while I was biting the apple pie. From then on, I liked to eat apple pies. Fortunately, I can have it in many places now. Because Mc'Donald sell it. You should try it next time.

subject: IW-0803
content: There are many kinds of restaurants in Taiwan, and I am fond of having meals in those special ones. However, I love Japanese food the most.I have been to Japan twice with my family, and those memories are so great that I can't forget them. So, when I start eating Japanese food, I will remember that beautiful country and hope to visit there some day in the future.Of coures, Japanese food is delicious. I'd love to taste it especially seafood. It's different from other country. They eat fish without cooking! Some people may not like that, but I want to try it because it's special.

subject: IW-0803
content: There are many exotic food in Taiwan. All of them I like American food the best. For example, hamburgers, fries and coke. I usually go to the fast food restaurant to eat them with my family or my friends. I feel free and happy in the restaurant. Because I can see many children play happily or enjoy the soft music there. Since I am still a student, I don't have enough money to eat expensive food. I usually choose cheaper food like these. The other reason why I like American food is they have good smell. Their smell can make me relax and excited. I know they are not good for our health, but I will not stop love fast food but eat less in the future.

subject: IW-0803
content: To eat is the most important thing in my life, because I like to eat anytime. I have eaten many other countries' food just like China food, Tai food, Japanese food and so on. Which can always attrat me is Taiwanese food. One of the reasons is I love Taiwan, and the other is that their flavor are different from others. I like the traditional noodles called "Yun Troon" which is easy to make. But Pearl Milk Tea is still my favorite. I think I can't live without it. Its pearls interest me at times. How delicious it is! The most importance is that it is really Taiwanese food. I am proud of it.

subject: IW-0803
content: Here comes my dish! What is it? Of course is my favorite foreign food - pasta! I am in an Italian restaurant now and I always order that dish. Once I go to a foreign restaurant, I always search the menu to check whether it offers pasta or not. Why do I like pasta? Because I like potato sauce on it, and the noodles which look yellow and bright make my apetite open. Besides, the smell of it also can let my energy regain. Therefore, pasta becomes my first point to consider a restaurant's bad or good. Eating pasta, I feel that I am top of the world and that all my bad mood is cast out! I also get a part-time job to work in Italian restaurant, learning how to make pasta. Without a doubt, pasta has become a part of my life and it will last a lifetime.

subject: IW-0803
content: People in Taiwan can taste other countries' food. Like, American, Indian, Hong Kong.... I like Taiwanese food best. The second is American's food, particularly, fast food. I like it's not only fast but also delicious. The important reason is the price I can afford. Although it is not healthy, but it is still my favorite foreigner food now.

subject: IW-0803
content: Taiwan is a melting pot. There are so many different kinds of groups. In night markets of Taiwan, you can enjoy a lot of delicious food. Take myself as an example, I'm fond of Japanese food. At the street of Taiwan, you can find a variety of Japanese restaurant. There are so many sorts of Japanese food. The most I like is sa shi mi. When it comes to sa shi mi, the most important thing is to dip some wa sa bi. I enjoy the flavor when they are mixing with. Before you eat, you should be cautious to its fresh, or you will get a stomachache. Be careful before you eat the foreign gurmat.

subject: IW-0803
content: There were many kind of food in the world, most of them were delicious, and fast food was my favorite. Fast food was come from America, and it was convenient to eat for why it was called "fast". Fast food consist of many food, like hamburger, fried chicken, coke. It was more popular in recent years. I liked it because I could not only enjoy its delicious but eat it in everywhere and everytime. What a convenient food!!

subject: IW-0861
content:
I think the old saying is absoulutely correct, that's why we can see "priority seat" on bus or the MRT.
A rich man said, "The money I have is what you borrow me for a while, I must make the money back to each corner of this world."
Once I got two thousand from my grandpa, I was rather happy at that time, and made a list for all the things I wanted. Just at that very moment, a saying from a book came to me, "We use the money for what we want, but the poor can buy what they need, which is more important, toys or bread?" I tore the list, and told my grandpa that I want using the money to help the people who need them.
To help other people, we may lost something, just as time, money, or else, but we can also gain happiness from them, isn't it a wonderful choise?

subject: IW-0861
content:
I agree this sentence of course. When you see the boy or the girl that up helped is smiling at you. You will feel relieve and get happier.
I always like to help people at school, like classmates and teachers. Because I am a class leader, many classmates need my help. One time, the physic teacher gave us a lot of difficult homework to do, some classmates know I usually get good grades on the test, and they decide to copy my homework this time. When I heard that, I didn't get angry, improve my classmates' grades is good to me, so I taught them an hour and an hour, forgetting to do mine. The next day the teacher checked our homework, they all do well and the teacher seems to look happy and a little strange. The teacher looked at me and asked why I didn't do my homework. I explained to him and my classmates roared with laughter. He didn't punish me and told me to be more careful next time. My classmates all thanked to me, and that make me feel very happy.
That's why I love to help people, not only at school but all the things that you can see or touch.

subject: IW-0861
content: My father always tells my that helping people makes you feel happy, so I help people who needs help. One day, I went shopping with my friends in the department store. When we arrived, I saw a little girl crying. I asked her if she needed some favor. She told me she got lost with her family, she didn't know what to do. I took she to the information deck. Finally she smiled. She saw her family waiting for her. Her mother said, "Thank you" to me many times. Then, I and her family became new friends, I agree helping people makes you feel happy, so I can make new friends. At that time, I suddenly remind that Helping people makes not only you but also the people who you helps feel happy.

subject: IW-0861
content: Many people think "Helping people is happy". I think is true. When we are helping people, we also learn something new for ourselves. If you help people, maybe you will also find some mistakes about yourself. Last week, I helped my classmate, Joe, with her Math. In fact, I'm not very good at Math. But when I helped her, she also taught me some new ways to solve questions. The next day, we all got good grade and felt happy. Maybe some people think is difficult to help people or think it's waste time to do it. But you will find you not only help others, but also help yourself. After this; you will feel happy and successful.

subject: IW-0861
content:
The old said that "Helping people is the beginning of happy." I agree with this compeletly.
Although you seem can't get anything from helping someone others, you will hear the person who need your help to say "Thank you" to you with a big smile.
Last weekend, when I was shopping at a department store, I saw a little girl crying. She seemed lost. I gave her some candy and asked her some question about where she get lost. She stoped crying and told me that her mother is in a red dress. Soonly, I found a worried woman in a red dress and pick the little girl to her.
The woman said "thanks for your help" to me many times. As me, it was just a small help, but as the woman, she almost lost her child.
Sometimes, our little kindness can be helpful to people who need help. Best of all, helping people can also make yourself feel happy!

subject: IW-0861
content:
I always belive in that helping people is the source of happiness. I like to help people with anything. If someone want me to do something for them, I will try my best to finish the work, even I have no idea at first.
When I was in elementary school, many of my teachers asked me to corrected the test books and the homework for them. At first, I didn't know how to mark a report, but I would ask the teachers for help. After graduated from school, I became a person who can mark 35 test papers in only 15 minutes.
I think helping people can not only make you happier but also wiser. For example, if you don't know how can you do to help someone at first, you will go to ask others to teach you. After doing so, you will have a new experience that what you can do at such a period.
In sum, if you are smart enough, you will feel happy when you are helping doing something.

subject: IW-0861
content:
I think that helping people really brings me a lot of happiness. Because when someone were in trouble, and really need our help, if we helped them they would be really thankful. Here is an experience of helping people from me.
One day, I was on my way home, when I crossed the intersection. A man was bumped into a car. He fell down and began to bleed. At that time, I was scared, didn't know what to do. After a few minutes to calm down, I called the police. When the police come, I took the man who was in the traffic accident to the hospital. He didn't hurt too much. After doctor gave him some medicine, he said "Thank you" to me.
At that moment, I think it is really a big happiness for me to help others. So that's why everyone says "Helping others brings you happiness."

subject: IW-0861
content:
I agree at this saying very much. Helping others can really make myself feel happy. It's great to know that I can do something for other people. Since we were born, we have received so much help from others. Helping others means that you are different from before. In addition, imagine how excited you'll be when the person gives you a smile and says "thank you" to you!
I remember that once when I was a student in junior high, one of my classmates caught a bad cold and couldn't come to school for a week. She was the best student in our class, and I thought that she would be worried about the class and homework very much. Therefore, I lended my notes to her and answered all her math questions as possible as I could. I tried my best to help her because she was really a nice person.
After a month, she finally undersood all the class she had missed. She got good grades again on the final exams. I can swear that it was the best time in my life when she says "Thank you very much!"

subject: IW-0861
content:
It's a good deed to help others. Did you ever helped anyone? Well, I did. Yesterday, I took my trash out. When I was about to throw my trash into a dump truck, I saw an old women strethfully holding a big box of things to recycle. I could tell from her face that the box was very, very heavy. I put down my trash and went to help the old women. I asked the women if she needs my help. She said no but handed the box to me anyway. The old women thanked me severl times. All of the neighbors who saw me clapped for me, and said that I'm a very friendly person. That made me very happy. Even now when I'm writing this test paper, I have still got this special feeling in my heart.
So, helping others, doesn't just make the person who was helped feel good. Infact, helping other give ourselves a feeling. This feeling is very special, It makes one feel very comfortable and all of the trouble he have will go away. So, help other! Don't just be the one who is being helped!

subject: IW-0861
content: I agree that when you help others, you can also feel the joy yourself. You don't need to have a reason to do so, you can even help a complete stranger. I once helped an elder lady find her way home. She was lost in the crowds at the MRT station. I helped her find diections and lead her to the right root. As I waved goodbye she repeatly thanked me for what I did. It was really me who had to thank her, for helping me learn that helping others can bring joy to oneself. It is a giving from the heart, and a reminder to us that there are many others who's troubles are far more greater than our own. By helping those in need, you can feel rapture and joy, and that you've really made a difference in someone's life.

subject: IW-0861
content:
Many people say, "Helping people will make ourself happier." I agree this sentence very much. After helping a person, we will feel very comfortable, and we can also make many friends if we always helping people. I am a person who always like to help people, so I have many experience. I like the feeling after I finishing helping people, I really feel happy after that. And the person who is helped by me always say "thank you" to me.
I helped a child six months ago. When I was on the way home, I saw a little boy crying, but nobody want to help him. Everyone just looked at him then walked by, I felt very angry at that time. So I walked forward and asked him what's happened. He said he got lost and couldn't find his sister. I took him to the policer station to ask if the policer can help him. But when the little boy and I went into the police station, a girl suddently ran in front of us. She is the little boy's sister. They hug each other and cried loudly. Though it's really like a soapopera, but is true, and we still keep in touch now.

subject: IW-0863
content: In my life, lack of music is very terrible. I like to listen music and sing a song. When I study and do everything, I need to listen music. If I don't have music, I will not focus on everything. It is very important for me to listen music. I often listen rock and classic music. Rock music can make me more dynamic. When my mood isn't well, I always listen classic music which can make me stay calm. This different music is character. I can't lose music because music is my life.

subject: IW-0863
content:
Music is important to me for the following reasons. First of all, when I am happy or in a bad mood, I listen to the music to relax myself or cheer myself up; I sing after the music and sometimes dance. I like the music with me while I am studying math; it sometimes helps me figure out the question which puzzles me. I also like to listen classical music while I am sleeping. It makes me fall asleep quickly.
My favorite type of music is popular music with drums. The tample makes me exicted and energetic. Usually, I will take the MP3 with me which has many popular songs in it. I can listen to it whenever I want and wherever I go. In conclusion, music is not only important but also a part of my life.

subject: IW-0863
content:
I think that music is an important part of life and is to me either. Music is to my daily life what water is to mankinds. Music like a magician, it make the world more wonderful and colorful. I listen to it everyday. No matter waiting the bus or sleeping or when I under lots of stress.
It have lots of music in the world like classic, fashion, opera, hip hop but my favorite is classic, it makes me relax when I under lots of presure, it makes me happy when I am in the bad mood. It helps me easier to sleep, so music is very important for me. If I would be deaf oneday, I'll go to die than living in the world where without of music.

subject: IW-0863
content:
Nowday people life is too busy and full of stress. What would you do with the stress? My answer will be play the piano or listen music. Music is important for me, whenever I'm tried, sad or full of stress, I will listen music to make my feel confortable.
In such various kind of music. I like nature music the most. You can hear bird singing, waves with single piano or violin. This kind of music let me feel I am walking in woods or standing beside the sea. I will listen music after school when writing homework. Sometime I listen pop music too, and dance whit its tempo. I think music must be everyone "best-friend".

subject: IW-0863
content:
Music is the best thing in the world. There are a lot of kinds of music, and each kind of music has its own style. In addition, music affecting a lot of people, and being an important part of our life.
When I was sad, I listened to classical music. Classical music is soothing and relaxing. However, when I was happy, I listened to rock music. Rock music's tempo let me feel good. The other kinds of music, for example, Jazz, R&B and punk music are also my favorite. Music is important in my life. No matter where I am and what I do, music will be with me.

subject: IW-0863
content:
When I was young, I usually went to a concern with my grandfather, and he often told me "No matter how do you feel, just singing, it can make you more happier."
Therefore, when I feel sad, I always sing a song, it seems that nothing I should be afraid; if I do, I can solve anything.
Besides, when I'm happy, I also sing some song to represent my mood; whenever I ride a bike, I usually sing a song, it isn't only make me more happier, but also make me remind my grandfather; the time that I lived with my grandfather was always happy.
Even though I usually went to a concern with my grandfather, the types of music that I and Grandfather like are different; my favorite type of music is hip-pop; even if sometime I can't understand the meanings of the song, I can dance with the tempo and it make me more happier.

subject: IW-0863
content: Music is everywhere on earth. For me, it really plays a significant part in my life. Not until fifth grade in the elementary school did I lose myself in it. At that time, I always watched the television to listen to the pop music and talked about music with friends at school. As time passed by, for the sake of studying, I bought an ipod with poetic English songs in it. In my opinion, listening to soft English songs can not only make myself calm down and concentrate on the books but also keep me away from others' noisy sounds. What's more? While others enjoy Chinese popular songs, I think that listening to English songs is really a benefitial approach of learning English. Now, I really can't live without those graceful and touching music.

subject: IW-0863
content:
When I was a ten-year-old little girl, I joined the school chorus, we practiced almost every day and night, and finally we got the champion in the student's musical contest. Although the training was hard, I enjoyed the beautiful chord and the feeling that two parts of voice bound to one piece. To be brief, I love singing from then on.
Music can soothe my mind. Every time I feel bored, tired or sad, I will turn on the radio or CD player to listen to the music. I like all kinds of music except rock. Because the rock music make me feel noisy and nervous especially that heavy metal sounds. Above all, I like classical music the most. When I play the CDs, I will think of the producers' lives and their hometowns. I always imagine the fantastic landscape in Europe, and I wish I could go there some day. Music becomes a part of my life. I cannot imagine my life without music.

subject: IW-0863
content:
You get up in the morning and put a jazz CD into the CD player. You sing along with the singer while making breakfast. On the way to work, you can see a street performer singing his own song in the MRT station. During lunchtime, the colleague next to you is listening to a pop radio. On the way home, you can still hear classical music comes out from the cafe.
We can find music almost any time and everywhere. For me, it's an important part of my life. I sing ballad songs when I feel sad. While reading books, I would like to have some classical music surrounding me. Rock and roll is the best medicine to relieve my stress. I love music and I will keep my hobby the rest of my life.

subject: IW-0863
content:
Nowadays, most people live under lots of pressure from their work, families and schools. Like me, most of my stress comes from the school. To take a rest and release all the stress, I listen to music. Sometimes, music help me to forget about bad things. Other times, music shouts out my anger. With no music, I would never have a chance to sit here and write this article.
Of course, I won't love all kinds of music. There are two kinds of music I love the most, Classic and Rock music. There is a great difference between these two, but they both helped me a lot. Classic music makes me feel relax. It makes me see the most beautiful scene in the world. Rock music is different. When I played my electric guitar and sing with the music, I released my wild heart. No matter what happened to me, I will listen to these music against all the pressure around me.

subject: IW-0863
content:
Music plays an important role in my life. I can't live without music. I like all kinds of music. When I feel upset, I will listen to music. It makes me feel better. I also listen to music when I am under pressure, then I will feel more relaxed and comfortable. Music can encourage me to go ahead.
My favorite music is classical music. I think classical music is beautiful and graceful, just like a ballet dancer. When I listen to classical music, I leave all the unhappy things behind. In as short, I think listening to music can help you live your life much better.

subject: IW-0863
content:
Music plays an important role in people's lifes. A good music can affect you a lot. It is possible that you can memorize it forever. As a result, music is important to my daily life. If the world lacked of music, I would feel bored to die. I think music can make me happy. It also make me feel comfortable. Therefore, I always enjoy listening my favorite music everyday.
There are a variety of musics in our life. Everytime I listened to music, I always had different feelings. Fore example, my favorite kinds of music is pop music. Why? When I was upset, I always find something interesting. Listening to pop music is a good way to relax me and make me happy. All in all, music has an influence on you life. Trying to find your favorite kinds of music now.

subject: IW-0863
content:
To me, the music is all my life. That is to say, I can't live without the music. The reason why I take the music as a part of my life is that every day when I wake up, I turn on the radio to enjoy the music that the DJ plays first instead of washing my face or brushing my teeth. When taking the bus to my school, I also listen to my MP3 player. What's more, I listen to the music on the Internet when using the computer at home. Of all specises of the music, I like pop songs the most. As a teenager, I not only relax but also know about the fashion by listening to pop songs.
According to the reasons mentioned above, I can't live a colorful life unless I have the music around me. In other words, the music plays an important role in my daily life.

subject: IW-0863
content:
Music is my life. I learned piano when I was five and stopped learning when I was twelve because I had to prepare for the BCTest. When I feel down or sad, I like to play the piano. It can help me to relax myself and so that I won't be weighed down by stress. So, for me, music is something that can make my mind much clear and balances my stress. I think I can't live without music, just as I can't live without sun and water.
My favorite kinds of music is classical music. Because what I learned before is classical music. Interestingly, classical music has a magic power that can make me feel calm and peaceful. I like to have a cup of tea and read some books at 3:00 p.m., of course, with classical music. It really makes me feel comfortable after listening to classical music. Every time I listen to classical music, I can feel my blood getting warm, my body getting soft and my mind getting much clear then before. I really really enjoy it.
People think that music is just music. But for me, music is not just music, music is all my life.

subject: IW-0863
content:

content:
Well goes the Chinese saying, "helping people is the sourse of happiness." I used to regard that as a humbug; however, after an experience of helping a stranger, I came to agree with it.
It was the summer vacation two years ago when my father asked me to go to the hospital he works in to be a volunteer on weekends. Reluctant as I was, I went to the hospital on time at seven o'clock a.m.. Wearing the volunteers' vest, I was extremely embarrassed for fear that any of my acquaintance would see me. However, after answering several patients' questions, I gradually got relaxed. Then, an old man dragged himself with a stick to my front and asked me to take him to the places of body examinations. After asking other volunteers, I took him to the places written on the body examination paper one after another. When he eventually finished all the examinations, it was two thirty p.m.. Hungry though I was, I felt a sense of fulfillment when I heard the old man says, "Thank you very much, boy." With the happiness derived from the several simple words, all the work I'd done was paid. After all helping people can not only make others' lives easier, but also make your own life more fulfilled and happier.

They asked the driver how to get to the railway station in English. But the driver ignored them. I thought that maybe he didn't understand what they were saying. And I volunteered to guide them to their destination. They said there was a Taiwan friend waiting for them. When we reached the station, I found that their friend was my supervisor in work. My supervisor thanked me for helping them, and I really made a good impression of myself to him. At the same year, I got a promotion which was strongly recommanded by my supervisor.
Helping others can benefit both the helpers and those who need help. I think we should pay attention to everything around us, and reach hands to people in need anytime.

subject: IW-0861
content:
Helping people is the best thing. It is said that helping people is the best thing around the world. In my opinion, helping people is good. Many people in the world often need others' help. If you help those who need help, it can let you fine because you think that you just do the right thing instead of doing nothing. And if you usually help others, they will help you when you need help because they are thankful to you.
In my childhood, I have a experience that someone helped me when I needed help. Because of it, I started helping people who need help. When I was ten, I had a accident when I played with my classmates on the street. My leg was broken. At that time, everyone was left expect one passerby. He help me go to the hospital and tell the accident to my parents. I was thankful to him. After this, I always help people who need help. And after helping people, I become happy. I think that this is why helping people is the best thing around the world.

subject: IW-0861
content: As the says goes, "Happiness is based on helping others." What a great sentense it is! It's so surprising that it's my motto, and I enjoy helping who needs help. Take my experiense for example. One day, I was on my way home. I saw a cute girl crying alone. I was so curious that I talked to her what happened. She lost the road and no one helped her. Because of my kindness, I asked her phone number, calling to her parents. Finally, her parents picked her up, and she was grateful for me. After this event, I told to myself, "It's such a great experiense!" I am very gald to help everyone, and do my best to solve their problems. As long as I am able to do, I would convey my love to everyone. If one could help others, the world would become much better.

subject: IW-0861
content:
Of course, I agree with this sentence because it's happy for me to have opportunities to help those in need. On the other hand, you can hear that someone says "Heaven helps those who help themselves and others." And also, you will be happier after you help somebody. In a nutshell, I agree with it undoubtedly. Now, I want to share one of my experiences with you.
Someday, I saw some charity volunteers in the road on my way home. They had several donation boxs. I hesitated to put my money in it because I just received it from my parents and I wanted to buy a new magazine. But after a moment, I saw a little girl reached into her bag and put all her pocket money into the box. I thought many people who live in poverty or in remote village suddenly after seeing it. As these results, I contributed all my money to them instead of purchasing a magazine. Every volunteers were gratitude to me.

subject: IW-0861
content:
There is a saying going that helping other people is the basis of happiness. Many people believe in this saying. In my opinion, I also think it is right. There are some reasons as follows.
First, if you help other people, they will also help you when you need help. And after other people help you, you will be happy. Second, it is amazing that you will be happy just after you give others a hand. For example, three days ago when I took a big test, my classmate forgot to bring his pens. Then I gave him my pen. As soon as I helped him, I felt happy for no reason.
In short, you will feel happy when you help others, so you had better try your best to help other people.

subject: IW-0861
content:
In my viewpoint, I agree that helping people can get happiness. If you help others to solve their difficult problems, they may be very happy and appriciate for you help. Thus, you receive the appriciation and will be very happy about that.
Say my experience about helping others. Yesterday, I played basketball with my classmates. Suddenly, the ball hit my friends' glasses and his eye was bleeding. We were so shocked that we didn't have any idea how to do. Then my first thought was send him to the hospital. I borrowed my friend's cell phone and called 119. Before the car came, I sent him to the toilet to clean his blood on his eye, and used issues to cover his eye. No sooner the car came, he was sent to the hospital.
After the accident, he said "thank you" to me. I was very happy. Therefore, our friendship became stronger and stronger.

content:

She said "How nice a girl you are, thank you very much." with a kind smile which made me feel so warm and happy. After the experience, I learned that it's better to give a aid to others rather than recieve a help from others.

Finally, I helped with the boy avoiding sent to the police office and persuad the woman not to be so strict to a child.

subject: IW-0861
content:
An old saying says "Helping people is the root of happiness." I agree with it. When you help a person, you will feel very happy. The feeling of happiness isn't because you can get praise by anyone, but because you have the ability to help others. There are many examples proving this saying worldwide.

When I saw them confused by Chinese sign, I went to them and explained the meaning to them by English. After explaing the meaning, I also took them to walk around my school. Finishing the visit, they said "We are appreciate for your help!", and I feel very happy.

subject: IW-0861
content: Helping people is a good thing for us. It is said that helping people is the basic to be happy. subject: IW-0861
content: In recent years, Helping others is the source of happiness has become a public focus. In my opinion, I agree to it. First of all, we do other people a favor, we will have a lot of fun. For example, if we help who is handicapped or disability, they will be easier to live in the world, and we would be glad that we have a lot of abilities to help other people. The traffic situation is terrible and awful. I had a really hard time doing the old lady a favor. But, I did had not given up easily. Finally, I made it. I was in a good mood. content:
Music is indispensable to my life. Music can relax my emotion. I love music very much. When I am under a lot of stress, I should listen to the music to help me relax. subject: IW-0863
content:
Someone said that there have a song in everyone's heart. Music play an important role in our heart. Because I listen to music when I am in the bad mood. Listening music can help me feel better. Listening music also make me get more attention when I'm studying school work. I'm a twelve grade student. There are many pressures bothering me. Listen music can reduce some pressures. So music play an important role in my heart.
Some people loved quickly songs, and others loved slowly songs. I loved the latter. The slowly songs can make me feel clam when I'm angry, sad or agonish. My friends introduced some quickly songs to me in the past. But quickly songs always made my blood acceleration. Finally, I only listen slowly music instead of the both.

subject: IW-0901
content:
You have stayed at school all day long, with every nerve strained. After going back home, you continue striving against piles of books for the tests tomorrow. Before going to bed, you are totally maxed out, and reading another book will definitely be like the last straw on the camel's back.
Students now have so many boring text books to deal with that they lose interests in getting extra knowledge gradually. This extracurricular reading deprived phenomenon will cripple the quality of our students.
To improve this worrying situation, I suggest that schools reduce the ceremonious part in the text book, which might be considered tedious to students, and put in more practical or daily-life article instead. By doing so, students may have more tendency to read even more books because things mentioned in the books are what they are interested in.

subject: IW-0901
content:
Students tend to read less because there is too many other things that would draw there attention. What could we do about it?
TV, computers, games and so on has been presented to students. If you give them a choice between book or TV, they'll usually choose the later. Here's a way to encourage them to read. Pay attention to what they usually watches on TV or plays on computers. If they like adventure movies, you can try to let them read books that is about adventures. This way, with interest, they'll want to finish the book. After a few more books, they'll start asking you to buy more, and then, they can never stop. In the future, you won't have to worry about them not wanting to read anymore.
But before all of the above, try to be a good example for the students, so that they would be inspired and really get interested by the magic of books.

subject: IW-0901
content: Today, many students lack the habit of reading. I think there are two possible reasons: First, students now have so many tests that they spend lots of time preparing for them. Furthermore, they are tired of studying all the time from their textbook, so they finally loose the enthusiasm of getting more knowledge from reading other books. Second, we are living a life of high technology, we can easily get information from watching TV or surfing on the net It is easier and more convenient than reading books. But that doesn't mean that reading isn't a good way to learn. We should encourage students to read because reading still has many benefits. Schools can put reading into a program. Teachers can also help the students to read together and share their own thought. It's important to make reading become an interesting activity. In that way, students will not get rid of reading any more.

subject: IW-0901
content:
Many students do not have a habit of reading. I believes that there are some factors for it. The most important one is that we have lots of things to do when we are free, such as shopping, watching TV, playing computer games, and so on. These things are more attractive to students. Students usually want to throw the books away and do something else. If we can publish more kinds of books and lower the prices, it may attract people to buy some books and read. Teachers should cut down a few assignments and tests, figuring out some encouragement for reading books. In this way, I think that students will tend to reading.
In some countries, they had some tips for this issue. Maybe we could get some good ideas from their researches.

subject: IW-0901
content: In recent years, more and more students have shown little interest in reading. Their lives have been filled with computer, video games, TV, and a lot of works or tests waiting to be done. Therefore, many students think of reading as a waste of time; some of them even think reading is very boring. I think the key to solving the problem is to tell them the importance of reading and the things people would gain through the reading process. Also, encouraging students to form a reading group may help. The reading group let students talk about their feelings and thoughts from books. I am sure during the time when they are sharing their opinions, students will gradually find out reading is not lonely or boring anymore.

subject: IW-0901
content:
No one can deny that the hobby of reading has become increasingly popular. But, as a matter of fact, people nowadays, such as students, are lack of the interest in reading. The reasons why this phenomenon is so common in Taiwan are as follows: First and foremost, almost students lead a stressful life and they want to engage some outdoors activities instead of reading. Furthermore, they might think reading is a time-wasting thing. To save time, they would do some efficient activities. Last but not least, some books are so expensive that students can't afford to buy it on a regular basis.
Nevertheless, I still consider reading to be a tremendous hobby. As far as I'm concerned, whenever I have time, I read books every now and then. I think the authorities concerned or teachers have to come up with some measures, such as rewarding students, to stimulate students to read. In conclusion, reading is an awesome hobby, making our lives more colorful and entertaining, so everyone needs to get into the habit of it.

subject: IW-0901
content:
Nowadays, many students don't have the habit of reading in their free time. Parents might think that their children have to be focused on their studies so that they prevent children from reading books except for the textbooks. Besides, after some students have studied all day and feel exhausted, they just want to watch TV or play computer games. However, I think every one shold get into the custom of reading every day because reading can broaden our horizon. I love reading a lot, and here are some ways to encourage other students to read more books.
For instance, schools can hold such activity like inviting famous writers to school. By talking face to face with the students, students get to develop an interest in the book and the author. Besides, teachers can choose some books which are related to the lessons. After the students read those books, teachers can give them a chance to share their opinions with each other. By doing so, students can know other's reflection and learn different points of view. They can even make a drama based on the plots in the book!
These are only some of the methods to encourage the students to read more books. I hope that every one can realize the importance of reading and develop a long-lasting interest in books.

subject: IW-0901
content:
Lacking of proper reading habits is the common problem for students nowadays. As far as I'm concerned, there are two main reasons for the "unhealthy" situation: one is the cram education system in Taiwan, the other is the highly-attractive power of computer.
Mostly, students are under high pressure of schoolwork, which makes them become passive and exhausted learners. Instead of doing outdoor activities or broadening reading, the colorful Internet or computer world has become the main choice for students to kill time.
How can we encourage students to build up better reading habits? First, teachers can set up "Reading Corners" in every classroom. Various genres of books will absolutely stimulate students' interest. Also, providing different 'prize-giving' rules and forming study groups will be helpful. At last, turning off TV and computer to give ourselves a quiet and cozy environment for reading, it will empower us both mind and soul.

subject: IW-0901
content:
You go to a school library to borrow a book and find that there are not many students in it. It means that more and more students don't have a habit of reading. I think there are some reasons in it.
The study pressure is so heavy that students don't have time to read. After they study the school works, what they want to do is sleep. Only when students are in their vacation do they read some book. Then, computers are very common now. Some students think that using a computer is much more interesting than reading.
I think that the teachers could encourage students to read more books by helding a competition of reading report or founding students reading groups. In my school, after students read a book, they discuss the story and report to the classmates.
Reading is a good way to improve your knowledge. We should read more and have fun doing that!

subject: IW-0901
content:
As we're complaining about the students who lack the ability to write good articles, we may find out the reason behind, lack of reading.
Just as the rapid development of our technolgy and the prosperity of our human civilization, more and more demands on convenient electronic appliance occur; consequently, more and more students put aside their time of reading, changing into playing computers, watching TVs, or going shopping, all of which become the reasons why we're moaning and groaning about students' lack of reading habits.
We can also take actions to prevent these from happening. First, it's a good idea to change the traditional and conventional types of books as they're the ones whick aren't able to keep up abreast with the times stop students from reading. Second, we can control the time of students' access to the technological products; in the consequence, they have time to read.
When we're reading, we're gaining knowledge. Reading is the best way of study as we can know more within only a few hours whereas the author did it for a long period of time. And now, I'm starting to read my favorite book.

subject: IW-0901
content:
There are many reasons why students seldom have the habbit of reading today. First of all, modern students spend too much time watching TV, which will keep them from the joy of reading. Secondly, students are usually busy studying, so they don't have much time to read. Finally, students have to read so many text books that make students become afraid of reading.
So what should we do to encourage students to pick up a book and read? For one thing, we can give them some books with interesting stories or colorful pictures such as magazines. Besides, we can tell them not to watch too much TV. Instead, they can read some books to pass their free time. Furthermore, we can provide them with a comfortable and convenient environment to read.
As water is to fish, so is reading to people. Reading enriches our knowledge and broadens our horizon. Students should read as much as possible.

subject: IW-0901
content:
Students nowadays are often lack of the habit of reading. This isn't a good phenomenon. There are several reasons why students don't read very often. For one thing, the technology has improved. There are so many entertaining gadgets that lure students, such as TV programs or on-line games. Students don't need to rely on reading to kill the time. For another thing, students are too busy going to cramschools. As soon as they come back from schools, they are sent to cramschools. They stay at cramschools studying until nine or ten o'clock. They don't have much leisure time to read books whatever they like.
Students need to read more, or their language reading comprehension and writing ability won't improve. How can we encourage students to read? First, teachers can arrange classes to the library and read. This offers students opportunities to read. Second, teachers can ask their students to do reading reports as homework. Then students will have to open some books and dig in.
Reading can benefit us a lot. Students should read more often because there is so much to learn from reading.

subject: IW-0901
content: Nowadays, students lack a habit of reading. This happens because most of the students find nothing interesting inside books. They think that books are written for tests. Parents beat them to memorize words and phrases, or write long book reports. Here are some ways to increase students' interests on reading. First, parents can allow students to select books that they like to read, but don't ask them to remember vocabulary words inside the book. Second, think of some prizes that students like. Give the prizes after students finish reading a book. This can attract students, too! Third, take them to libraries and take a look at some special exhabits, or listen to someone telling amazing stories inside books. Last, share your thoughts with students. Through these steps, you can discover the students love on reading, Of course, their writing skills will improve, too! Starting today, why not lead them to become "reading fans"?

subject: IW-0901
content:
Nowadays, our lives are filled with high-tech products, such as computers, video games, and so on. Therefore, many students don't like reading any more. They think that those books are boring and out of date.
But in fact, reading can bring a lot of advantages to our lives. It can broden our horizons and those beautiful articles can lead variety to our lives. As a result, teachers and parents can use some methods to make the students read. I think that using some awards and prices can encourage students to read. Because of these, students will start to contact with books and finally find that reading is an beneficial and interesting activity!
To sum up, though many students now think reading is not as exciting as those popular entertainments, reading can bring many benefit to our lives and let us feel pleasant as well. Hence, teachers and parents should encourage their students to read more in some useful way.

subject: IW-0901
content:
Increasing number of students spend little time reading in their free time. One of the reason why they dislike to read is Internet. More and more student are addicted to playing virtual games on the Internet, which cause them to have little time to read. Another reason is that there are too many kinds of comic books. Many students prefer reading comic books to reading some benefial books, such as an essay or newspaper and so on. Still another reason is that more and more students go to cram school or take part in a variety of club's activities after school, and this also lead them read less.
As far as I'm concerned, the best way to encourage student to read is that their teacher can set a goal like finishing five books within a week and whoever achieve this goal will be praised. Or the teacher can seperate her students into four of five groups, and each group has to pick up a book that really interests them and read the book. After they finish the book, they would have to deliver a lecture where they can tell the other students their feeling after reading the book. If we can take the steps mentioned above, I believe, more and more student will love studying in the future.

subject: IW-0901
content:
Many students currently are not in the habit of reading because many parents require that their children should pay attention only to their textbook. They think that reading extracurricular books will dirtract their children's attention. Another reason is that many students are indulged in video games, online games, and comic books. They think that reading is more tedious than playing.
In order to alter the situation, parents could offer something that their children are fond of as gifts, if their children read many books. Also, teachers could require that their students should hang in some reading paper so that students would have no alternative but to read some meaningful books. If they found that reading is interesting, they would form a habit of reading.

subject: IW-0901
content:
Students do not have the reading habbit these days. This is a world wide phenomena, not just here in Taiwan. From my point of view, I think there are three main reasons why students nowadays do not like reading.
First of all, there are too many kinds of both sound and visual effect entertainments that occupy most of students's time, which leave them little time to explore something else. Secondly, parents do not encourage them to read. They would ask students to read more but they wouldn't set the example for their children to do the same. Finally, there's nobody to guide them reading or to evoke their interest in reading.
There are two suggestions I would like to propose to resolve the issue. One is parents could encourage students reading by reading along with them. The other one is reduce the chance and the time the students spend on televisions or computers. This way, it would give them the opportunity to spend time on reading, since they have no other things better left to do.

subject: IW-0901
content:
There is no denying that reading is of central importance in learning, and it's also a great hobby for all people to have. With a good reading ability, you can deal with many things in life easily, and probably gaining some enjoyment when doing so. But students now seem to be lack of reading hobby, and it's a issue worth thinking about.
There are so many reasons responsible for this. First, computer games have been so popular with students in recent decades, and television shows also take them a lot of time watching. All of these result in the influence that students are only interested in audio-visual entertainments rather than reading. Second, it seems that students today don't really make use of their time. They usually splend too much time doing things which are not so important; and thus, ignore the importance of reading.
To solve this case, teachers in elementary schools should creat a good environment for students to read, and make them use to this, so they won't toss this hobby away when growing up. Governments can also set up some competitions of reading. For instance, the student who has read the most books will be awarded.
Once they begin to enjoy the process of reading, they will continue to keep this hobby for their entire life. So, join in! Come to have a taste of the great enjoyment of reading.

subject: IW-0901
content:
Reading is a good way to broaden your knowledge, but now a lot of students don't have the habit of reading. I think the reason is that now students are too busy studying, and even they've got spare time, they spend it on playing computer games or shopping. Many students think reading is boring. They've already study too much for the tests, so once they start reading the book, they might soon fall asleep. Another point is that now students only read or study for the tests. As long as there is no test, they throw the book away and start playing.
To improve this problem, I suggest the school or the government should incourge students reading by giving awards. The student who reads the most, gets an award from the school. Although students read may because they want the award, they will soon discover the fun of reading while they've read many books, and start reading just because it's interesting.

subject: IW-0901
content:
Students don't have the habit of reading books nowadays. I think that it is because of the high technology products. They can get all the information from Internet or televison, instead of reading books and newspapers. When they feel bored, they would play computer games rather than read novels; so that they don't have to "read"
We can't stop the development of technology, so we have to take other way. First, we should let students know the importance of reading. Second, we can try to get student enjoy reading, such like interesting books and novels. Third, we can also turn the books into "e-books", which are more convenient than real books. I'm sure that these solutions are very useful to help students to read.

subject: IW-0901
content:
Nowadays, most of the students don't keep reading as a habbit or even don't like to read. It's a pity that people can't enjoy the fun when reading books.
Because of the technology, students like to find information on the Internet instead of reading books. Students also spend most of their time watching TV, surfing the Net or going to the movies to relax themselves, not by reading novels anymore.
It is not difficult to read again. You can try to read thin books that are full of pictures first. Parents and teachers shouldn't give their children pressure when reading. It will make them feel that reading is a work, not a interest. They will not like reading or even hate it. The best way is, share the fun with children while reading books. You can also discuss the part that you both like the most. Above all, it's also very important to keep reading as a habbit when the children are still little.
Turn off the TV and find a book to read now! I'm sure that you will enjoy the stories and find out that reading is not such a boring thing!

subject: IW-0901
content:
Students nowadays are often lack of reading, and that may cause them lack of some commen sense.

Nowadays, students generally lack the habit to read, why is this? Parents and teachers blame it on the media, and they are correct. In the world today, students are exposed to the world of media for earlier than they would have twenty years ago, whereas twenty years ago, television wasn't as widespread as it is now, computers and the internet were almost non-existant, and students have nothing to do other than reading, students today make their contact with television and computer as early as age two to three, and, growing up with these two things, generally ignore reading.
How can we prevent such a problem if its a habit that's been set in place since childhood? One answer to the problem is to work straight from the start, limit the child's exposare to television and computers until at least halfway through elementary school, and let the child read progressively -- start from simple books, thick hardback books with simplely, easy-to-understand words and phrases, the progress to harder, more complex books. An error parents often make is that they give a child complicated books right from the start, not realizing one fact -- reading is a hobby that must be develope.

When the school is finished in the afternoon, students usually go to cram school. There, students keep studying probably until 9 p.m.. Finally, they go home and start taking a rest. Surfing the Internet, viewing others' blogs and watching TV are the things, which don't take a lot of effort, they will do only. After that, it's bed time. Apparently, it seems that there's no time for them to read. If there is time, they won't read, because they think it's too tiring, especially when they are exhausted. Surfing the Internet is much more interesting than that.
So, how to make students read? First, we can introduce some fun, short stories whose topic is interesting to students. Reading short stories won't take them too much time. Second, after the short stories, novels can be given to students as well. They'll probably keep reading them, because they want to know what will happen next in the plot. Last but not least, we can tell students that if they really do want to read, there will be always enough time for reading. What you only need is the attitude.

subject: IW-0901
content:
Nowadays, many students generally don't keep a habit of reading. As the television and internet become more and more popular and advanced, students spend a lot of time watching TV, surfing the net and playing online games with their friends. They get used to surround themselves with sound and light. Time by time, they become lazy to think and read.
There are some strategies to encourage the students to read. First, keep them away from the television and internet. Help them set daily reading goals (including the reading content and reading time). Give them little presents if they achieve their goal. Second, encourage their good friends to form a small reading group. The leader could be an teacher or one of their parents who enjoy reading. They could gather together once a week and choose a meaningful or interesting book to read. The discussion could force students to think and express their thoughts clearly. They could find reading interesting and cultivate the habit of reading. Last but not the least, is to surround the students with good reading materials and encourage them to find the fantasy of reading.

subject: IW-0901
content:
Today, most students don't have the habit of reading. One of the reasons that students don't enjoy reading anymore it that they think reading takes a lot of time, and they're very busy with other things. Another reason is that young people are used to the Internet now, and they can get the information they want from the computers efficiently. To them, there's no reasons to learn from books when they can learn from the Net much faster. Also, students are sometimes forced to memorize the context in the books they read, and that makes them feel bored and tired when reading.
There are many ways to get students into books. First of all, teachers and parents should make reading more attractive to students. For example, we should encourage them to read the books they like when they feel like reading them. Forcing a student to read a book that he or she doesn't enjoy will only make the situation worse. On the other hand, making the reading environment quiet and confortable is also helpful. Most important of all, adults should let the kids enjoy themselves when reading. If all the things above are done, I bet reading will interest the students very much in no time.

subject: IW-0901

Students don't have enough reading is a big problem in most of the schools in Taiwan. Nowadays most people have computers at home, and young people simply got hooked up to the Internet and got lost in the imagination world, which caused them to spend more and more time on computers in their free time instead of reading a good book. Another reason that students spend too little time reading is because there are way too many homework and exams they have to finish or prepare, and some students spend all their time in cram school after school to catch up on their homework, so they don't even have free time to sit down and read and relax.
This, of course, is a extremely serious problem, and I think the best way to make this situation better has to start with parents. Parents should spend time reading with their child when they're still little, so kids can discover the beauty and excitiment in good books, and they will love reading all their lives. That way when they grow up they will choose to be friends with books and choose to spend time reading instead of sticking their eyes on the computer everyday. On the other hand, I think teachers should encourage their students to read instead of giving them lots of homework, because many useful knowledge come from good books, and students can learn much more from reading than from textbooks and tests. Most important of all, reading brings happiness and smiles, and that's something homework cannot do.
Parents and teachers should work together to help their kids discover all the "goods" in reading, and what's more important is that students have to love reading and let books be their friends themselves. I love reading, and I hope everyone else in the world loves reading, too!
