I think financial management is extremely important. If we can save some money, we can't worry about emergency things like out of the job. If we can learn in advance, why not do it?

subject: IW-0962
content: I think take financial management to junior high school class is good. Financial management to a teenager is very important, because we need to take a ready to our future. And I think it can also training in teenager's self-control. So a financial management class in school is good. I usually save my money in bank every year. Sometimes, I will write "what I buy? and how much?" in my note. And if I want buy some more expensive thing, I will plan long time, and think twice wether it useful or needed.

subject: IW-0962
content:
I think it is very important to take financial management into education. Students in junior high school are supposed to know how they can use money. To save or to spend? When or where they can use money more wisely and correctly. If a person use the money in a right way, it will bring the most benefit. On the other hand, if he put it into a wrong way, it will get him into a big financial trouble. I considerate it is good to let teenagers know what financial management is.
My dad gives me one thousand NT dollars a month. I usually save it. Sometimes I use the money to send a birthday gift to my friends. When a new semester begins, I use my allowance to buy the textbooks. I think the way I use my allowance is right.

subject: IW-0962
content:
Financial management class will be hold in junior high schools. I think the class is important. Because the plan may help students make a good use on spending money. They should think more carefully when want to buy goods. In a long run, the student can make a good plan on not only financial but also their future.
Life itself is full of money, we money to pay tickets, to pay bill, to buy food, I spent all of my money. So, I think that I should join the financial management calss.

subject: IW-0962
content:
I think it is very important to have a Financial Management Class in junior high school. These days, more and more teenagers spend their money without thinking. This might be a big problem. And if they can learn how to manage their money, it can solve many problem. So, I totally support this plan.
To me, I do not have my own money. Because my parents hope I can use money carefully, I have to ask them before buying any expensive thing. Then, they will give me money after they agree with me. Although it is quite unconvenience to somebody, it sure can help me with my financial management. This is the way I manage money. But to most teenagers, they need "Financial Management Class" to help them manage their money.

subject: IW-0962
content:
I think financial management is really an important issue in our lifetime. It is never too early to learn this. As a junior high school students, they might have pocket money already. Taking this class will help them to manage their pocket money more efficially. They can learn how to manage their personnel financial through their pocket money.
My parents give me four thousands per month. I have prepared a notebook which I record the money I spent. Through this way, I can handle my budget well. If I have some money left at the end of the month, I will put it in a box where I save my money.
Building a correct concept of fanacial managemet is really important and can not be ignort. Putting this class in junior high school education is really a good idea.

subject: IW-0962
content:
The economy has collapsed these recent years. Jobs shed, business shattered, many people lost their homes. Since these kinds of things have taken place, isn't it important for us to learn how to manage the finance?
I think the idea of putting the financial management into the courses is essential. People ought to learn the way to manage finance, even students should do so. If they don't, it is impossible for them to be a good manager in the future.
I've never take the course of financial management in junior high school, but I learn it from handling my own allowance every day. Due to the reason that I don't have much money, I spend my money on the things that are necessary. I regard management as an important thing in my life.

subject: IW-0962
content:
The Educational Ministry plans to take the financial management in the education of junior high school. In my opinion, it is vital for us to learn how to manage our pocket money, because it will determine the way which we deal with our salary in future. Besides, financial management can not only prevent us from spending too much but help us use money more efficient.
I have five thousand per month for my pocket money. First, I will list what I want to purchase recently. Then, I will estimate how much I need to spend such as eating cost, transport cost. The rest is the extra money I can use. In that case, I can know whether I can buy or not. It is true that taking financial management in the education of junior high is beneficial, but one thing we need to be sure is the teacher must be able to solve their own financial problems so that they can teach their students the correct concepts.

subject: IW-0962
content:
I think it is important to add the financial management course to the education of junior high school. Most parents will help their children manage the money. For instance save it in the bank or invest it in the company. They will give the money to their children when they grow up. But, they didn't teach them how to manage the amount of money. Soon, these children will run out of money. So, I consider that teaching children how to manage their money is significant.
I have a job in the KFC. Usually, I will save my salery in the bank, but withdraw it seldom. When my parents' birthday coming or others important day, I will withdraw it. My parents taught me that not to waste money when I was a child. The lesson is always in my mind.

subject: IW-0962
content:
I think the financial management class is necessary. Since the credit card appeared, modern people have been prone to buying things without a second thought. As a result, the number of the bankrpted people is on the increase, leading the society to disorder.
In my opinion, I usually deal cautiously with my allowances by making a budget. For example, I add up my whole-week poket money and record every purchase I made, making it a rule to keep the benefit steady. Therefore, I can have enough money to handle the sudden need and leave my wallet filled with money in the long run.
Now that the importance of the financial management can't be over-emphasized, we had better overcome our inner desire for shopping. Besides, I urge that the authorities concerned take action for fear that those who can't afford the debt become the next victims. To sum up, the more precautions we do, the less damage it may cause.

subject: IW-0962
content:
In my opinion, the course about financial management for junior high school students is very important. The reason is that the most of students do not know how to use their money properly. They usually buy things which they like and don't think carefully if it is worth buying. Besides, if the students can learn how to use money in a positive way, they will have more chances to win others who don't know the aspect of money.
I think that the way I use money is proper. My mom gives me pocket money twice a month. I'll buy something useful for me instead of buying something useless. If there are something expensive and it is very important to buy, I will communicate with my mother and ask her to give me much money. My mom is convinced that I am a good child who has good habits about handling money.

subject: IW-0962
content:
Financial management is an important lesson for us. When we have our own money, we need to plan how to use it at first. If we have some plans before using it, it can be used in more ways. In my opinion, the lesson should be taught from younger people. Those who are younger can abstract the knowledge easily. When they become adults, they can make the right arrangement of money.
As for me, I usually make a list after getting my pocket money. The list is about what I need to buy, how much the thing costs, and how much I can save. Once I finish the paper, it's time to go shopping. Every weekend, I check the list for missing things. Most of time only few items have been changed, others have achieved my goal. Finally, I take the least money to the post office to save. And I will write a new list for next week.

subject: IW-0962
content: Nowaday, people are become very waste. When they are go shopping, they would buy a lot of things, and they don't know how to save money, so I think the financial management lessons is very important. When I get my salary, I will use it very carefully, I will not buy a lot of things or buy very expansive things. Instead, I will save my money or put the money in the bank, because I know that it is not easy to make money.

subject: IW-0962
content:
In my opinion, I think it's important to put the financial management lessons into junior high school lessons. The earlier the teenages know how to properly manage their money, the less financial problem they will face in the future. In modern society financial management involves great deal of one's life not just the career life but also the retire life. If one man don't know how to invest or reserve his income, soon he will find it difficult to maintain his daily life. So, I strongly agree with this policy.
I have my salary invest some funds and partly of it go to bank's account. Every month I usually spend a fix number of my salary and also a fix number give to my parents. Though I don't have car or house for now, it's better that keeping the money in the account than in out.

subject: IW-0962
content:
Nowadays, more and more people have problem with financial management such as credit card. Thus, the Education department decides to make junior high students learn about financial management. But in my oppinion, it is hardly useful.
First, most junior high students don't have much money. Meals, expense of bus or MRT, all the money they need is just a little amount. Therefore, parents hardly give junior high students too much money. Second, they are too young to know. As a junior high student, there are many subjects to study. Chinese, English, Math, history, etc, all of these subjects are annoying enough. Most important of all, they need to study for the exam to enter senior high. If we add FM class, they won't study hard because the exam is much important than the class.
To sum up, I think there is no need to add the FM class. The only thing everyone need to know is saving money. For me, I have saved my pocket money since junior high. And now, I am a fresh man. I can buy my own motorcyle without asking parents for money. Hence, what junior students need is just a idea of saving but not the FM class.

subject: IW-0962
content: I waste money very often. I always buy something that I don't need and spend all my allowance in the middle of a month. So, I think students must have to take financial management lessons in junior high school. If all the Taiwanese can study these kind of lessons, I guess there won't be lots of problems with our economy and society. From now on, I think I should change the way using money. I may start to save some money every month. However, I only should buy things that I really need.

subject: IW-0962
content:
The financial management has become more and more important to us. If we know the financial management, we can make money easily, and we won't spend much money on the things which aren't necessary for us. I think it is very important to teach the junior high school's students how to manage their money. They always buy many comic books, games, or go to the internet cafe'. Therefore, we must have to tell them that don't waste their money. There are some methods that we can teach them to know the financial management. First, the parents can give them some money a day. If students cost all the money, parents shouldn't give them any money. So that they will know that making money is difficult. Second, parents can also carry their children to the bank, and teach them how to save money into the bank. Last but not least, if parents don't spend a lot of money, their children will not spend, too.
My mom gives me just a little money every day. It will not over one hundred NT dollars. I have to eat breakfast and lunch, so I have no more money to buy another things. Besides, I don't buy drinks a lot. It is because that I think drinking water is more healthier. So I just spend a little money. Sometimes, I will buy some novels or comic books. I have saved some money for two months because I want to buy a game which attracts me a lot. Although my mom doesn't give me a lot of money, I still feel satisfy.

subject: IW-0962
content:
It's the time for globalization. No matter where you are, you can buy the other country' bonds or stocks. Usually we considered saving the money in the bank is a good idea, but investing in the stock market is more efficient way in fact. Therefore, the financial management is already considered the importment course now.
Usually I invested my money in the stock market, I choosed the way because it's a fast way to earn money although it has high risk relativily. In the meanwhile, I will invested the funds. The funds has low risk than the stocks.

subject: IW-0962
content:
To my view, I think the financial management course is important. Especially after watching news on TV which is about some young students threatened and stole their classmates money because of lacking money. If they had learned how to manage their money, they won't do that bad things.
As I receive my pocket money, I'll deposit my half money in the bank and use the other part money carefully. After each consuming, I'll take a record on my notebook. At the end of each month, I'll sum up my total money. By doing so, I never ask my mom to give me more money. On the contrary, I can buy some gifts to my parents to thank for their hard working. This is why I think this course is important.

subject: IW-0962
content: I think it is important for junior high students to learn the financial management. Nowadays, with the economy recession, there are more and more people losing their jobs, and face with the money shortage. The ability of financial management is consequently becoming very important. When I get my allowance, I divide it into two parts. One of them is used to pay for necessary things, while the other is saved in the bank. My parents teach me to do so, because I might find something that I truly want to buy someday. There is no predicting what situation we will meet. Therefore, it is quite crucial to have the ability of financial management in advance.

subject: IW-0962
content:
The education department has added the course of financial management to the junior high school courses. I think it is a very good idea.
Why? Because the students of modern days are all wasting money. They use their pocket money to buy everything they want. They don't know how to manage their money! The goverment should teach these students to aware of the money they use!
For instance, I always tell myself not to drink the juice and eat the fried chickens when I want. Maybe I can use these money to buy the books I love. Or maybe I can save it. When I "must" have to use those money, I can use them! So I think the way we use money should be more meaningful!
If everyone were having the right concept of financial management, everyone could be the rich!

subject: IW-0962
content:
I think it is important for children to take a financial management lesson. Someday they will grow up and have their own plan to decide how to use the money to make both ends meet. Nowadays, with the rising technology, children often stay with computers without living their childhood life to the fullest. The ability of dominating the usage of money isn't improving and even getting worse. For instance, when children saw the toys which attract them, they can't help but to buy it. This will lead to a tragedy that they don't have enough money to buy something more important such as books or meals. That's why I agree that it is necessary for children to take a financial management lesson.
To avoid the according condition happening, my parents refuse to give me pocket money. They think that I am too young to manage my money now. We draw the bottom line that I could have my pocket money until I enter the college.

subject: IW-0962
content:
It's good ideal about the financial management class! Nowday, child has a lot of money from their parents. It's more important to teach them hom to manage the money than just only nonstop give them what they want!
To me, I use my salary for three part. First, My life costs my salay the biggest part. Second, My family! I want to buy something useful for my dear parent. Third, My future day! I will invite, buy the house or car and so on.
In the end, let we control our life together!!!

subject: IW-0962
content: Financial management is important to everyone. Because many teenager can't use their money well. When they grow up, it's too slow to learn financial management. So, it's a great plan to teach financial management in junior high. When I take money from my mom, I'll keep some money for eat. Then I use the other to buy something I want. Maybe a CD, or shoes, cloth, books.... At last, I'll save some money if I still have.

subject: IW-0962
content:
I take positive opinion of the financial management courses. Since our student life from elementry to high school, we all emphasize on the acdemic aspect, language, history for example, yet we often forget some basic skills for students to live independently, which includes financial management, one of the most important skills of it. The idea of financial can help us make a better arrangement of our properties.
I first learned this idea from my mother when I was in the elementry school. I was so young and naive that I can hardly come up with any idea to deal with my money but saving it. When I came into college, one of my friend who decided to stop learning for work turned to me for help. I lent him fifty thousand dollars and owned twenty percent the stucks of his restaurant. Now I have nearly four thousand dollars a month for repaid. Hence I think learning how to deal with one's financial is essential for everyone, Not only to earn more money, but also to make the best use of it.

subject: IW-0962
content:
I think it is a good decition to do this. On account of financial management is also important to young people. Teaching them how to mange their money theirselves is useful to their life. Many young people don't know how to use their money brightly, despite of the fact that they have a lot of it.
I am accustomed to spending my money from my parents immediately when I got it. But now, I make a list about what I spend, so that I can buy what I want.

subject: IW-0962
content: I think that financial management is very important in education. Because financial mangement will influance many thing. For example, you don't have financial management you may buy a lot of thing but it is you need or you want? I will save 500 NT in a month. I will ues it on some thing I really need and help me.

subject: IW-0962
content:
In the modern society, we can pay money freely all around; however, chances are that we may struggle to make both ends meet. It is not unusual to catch news about young people who are unuable to pay money back comitting crimes. Therefore, learning how to manage money is an important issue nowadays. Teachers in schools can also arrange some lessons about financial management. By doing so, it can allow students to realize the problem before they step into society.
For me, it is easy for me to deal with my allowance. First, I have a habit of saving changes, which enable me to use money avalible when emergency occurred. Second, I will not buy the things that is unnecessary, so I can buy more books I want. In conclusion, money is the thing that everyone extremely wants, nevertheless, it is also the thing that may damage our life.

subject: IW-0962
content:
I think taking the financial management lesson into the junior high school is very significant. The follow are my reasons. First, knowing how to use the money before we enter the society is very useful in the future. Second, learning financial management will teach us how to save money and make the good use of the money. Last, with the financial management, we may easily become the millionaire one day.
I always save 60% of my allowance in the bank, because saving money is my top policy. Taking 10% of my allowance for the charity such as Red Cross or some foundations of disease and animals, because I think helping others just like helping myself. And the 30% of my allowance is for my daily time. I'll spend these money on food and the things I really need.

subject: IW-0962
content:
When it comes to the new political plan, adding the financial management to one of the junior educational course, I can't help but to agree this plan. In my opinion, it's absolutely important to learn that how to be good at financial management. There are some view I want to show you. First, being good at financial management can help oneself saving money, and cut down on some waste. In addition, you can clearly know that what is necessary to buy. Moreover, in the future, we can take part in the stock market more easily. We can also have more ability and way to manage our fortune.
In my childhood, I always spent all my allowance as soon as I take it from my parents, but the attitude to use money usually made me can't make ends meet. Now, I found a part-time job, and I have also my own money which is earned by myself. I start to write down the list when I go to buy things. This way really helps me to save money and I gradually know how important the financial management is.

subject: IW-0962
content:
I think it is an important decision. It can teach students how to spend their money as well as to save money. Because the condition of economy is worse than before. Everybody should figure out some plans to take care of his or her fortune. Young people wast their money too much. Because the money is from their parents. As a result, they use money to buy whatever they want. It's a bad habit to pay less attention to the value of money. So I support the government to put the financial management into education.
I am still a student now. And I know my parents' hardship. They go to work early and go back home late every day. So I seldom ask them to give me money to buy something. I request myself not to buy drinks as possible as I can. If I need to go to somewhere, I would take the bus instead of taxi. And I give my parents half part of my income when I have a part-time job. Last but not least, I put the money in the bank. When I grow up I can use the money to run a big company. So I can earn more money.

subject: IW-0962
content:
As for as I'm concerned, I think financial management is really important for everyone. Many people can't manage their money well, leading to being always lack of money or even having many card debts. If you can save our money and do financial management well, you'll never worry about money, many successful bosses just do it well. So it's proper to take financial management into courses of junior high school.
Take me for example, before buying things, I will consider again and again. If not necessary, I won't easily spend my money. When I get pocket money or salary, I will save it to the bank or invest stock tickets.
So just list a plan for financial managent of your own right now. The earlier you do, the more money you will save.

subject: IW-0962
content:
As a senior high school student, most of my classmates have pocket money, and it seems that the skill of using money becomes more and more important. You can use money in many ways, put it in the bank, buy something you need, for example.
The importance of financial management cannot be overemphasized. As the result, it's such a good news for me that the government is planning to add the financial management lesson into the education of junior high school. Financial management plays a important role in our lives, therefor, having correct conceptions since young would help us a lot.
Actually, I never have a plane of using money. I always save all of the pocket money and when I need it I will take some of it. I seldom spend money on entertainment and that's why I don't have to worry I might have no money. This is a workable way for me, but not for everyone.

subject: IW-0962
content:
I think the financial management lessons is important to everyone when they were young, because many people spent all of his salary to buy what he wants, and he will never save the money while he is really in need in the future. A good habit of financial management will help you how to use your money when you in need, So I think the financial management lessons is good for everyone.
I always save a part of my money in the bank, if I were in need I can use these money, and I can use another part of my money to buy what I want or go shopping with my friends. Anyway, I think the financial management is important to everyone.

subject: IW-0962
content:
To those who like to spend money, I think that it is necessary because many people don't get into the habit of saving money. Due to the economic downturns, many companies went bankrupt, and many people were out of work. That is to say, many people today are still unemployed.
I think that I have a good financial management. In my life, I always get into the habit of saving money. My mom once said, "Don't spend money on the useless things, it's not worthy." I had taken a part time job in a tutorial school since I was a senior high student. At that time, I saved all my salary instead of spending it. I have no desire to buy anything because I know that it is not easy to make money. I think that one man should have a good financial management.

subject: IW-0962
content:
I think the financial management lesson is important, because learning how to manage your money wisely, you could do more thing and make good use of spending or saving. First, if you receive the same allowence each week, but you want to buy your favorite CD, Then, maybe you could buy it with your saving money.
I usually put a half of my allowence in bank, and another half will keep it at home. I will write down what thing I want to buy, and then list their importance priority. Soon, I will buy it one after another. After spending the money, I will take the lefting coin inside my money pocket.

subject: IW-0962
content:
As a man who is care about the future of this land, I think there is need to put financial management into junior high school educational management. Because it need time to tell how important the financial is. The money are not easy to get them. So we have to learn the methods how to save them or made them more.
I am a sophomore of university. So most of money which still from my family. And I get 10,000 dollars each month. I don't usually spend all of them. I always keep some of them.

subject: IW-0962
content:
It is important to put financial management into junior education. Because many people didn't know how to management their money. Nowaday, lots of people used creadit card and spent more money over they can afford. It already made very serious problem for family, so I think the financial management is very important for all of people.
I used to use my salarit to divid three part, one of third to use in living express, another to pay in house loan, the other to save in bank account.

subject: IW-0962
content: I think it's important to put financial management in junior high school's education. Many parents will give their children pocket money when their children go to junior high school. But some of them spend all the money they have in their pocket, they seldom think of saving them in the bank. So school should teach students how to do financial management. Everyone should have the ability to manage their own money. In order to prevent them from becoming a person only knows shopping. I got my first pocket money when I was in junior high school. I divided it into half, I saved half and spent half. So when I want to buy something that's more than my monthy pocket money can take, I will use the money I have saved.

subject: IW-0962
content: It is very essential to join junior high education, because in this generation, how to deposit is became a issue, my parents always tell me the deposit is more important earn money, that's why we usually take our money to bank. How do I deal with my money? it's a good question, I often take half to my Mom the other put in my money box and save it, that's all, I have a big count in many years. I wish I can keep it.

subject: IW-0962
content: I think people should learn how to manage their money when they are young. Financial management is not only a concept but also a method to make ends meet. When people are young, the resource of their money is from their parents. If they don't make good use of their money, they would probably get into a habit of wasting money. As to me, when I receive the allowance from my parents. I usually save them into the bank. I only withdraw about one thousand dollars when it is necessary. I don't like to go shopping so I don't spend much money on it. I think when I want to buy a product, I will consider it is necessary or not. As being a college student, I think the financial management is much more important than before. I will keep a note about how much money I get from my parents and how much money I spend in this month. I think this habit will keep me reminding the importance of financial management. I think everyone should learn how to spend their money more wisely, and establish a concept of financial management. Only by doing these tips can people lead their lifes more wonderful.

subject: IW-0962
content:
Financial management is important for the young. Most of teenagers always spend their own money without thinking when they want to get something special. Therefore, they need to learn how to manage their own money.
I usually investigate friend's business. It help me earn money more easily, and it let me learn how important choosing time to investigate is.

subject: IW-0962
content:
As far as I am concerned, it is a wise decision for our government to put emphasis on financial management in the system of education. Nowaday, with many technology products releasing in every second, people have a host of desires to buy these cutting-edge goods. Some of them use the credict card or the cash card to buy things they want without hesitation. Without the management, many people strive to earn as much money as they can but still can't make ends meet. Furthermore, they have to pinch their money cautiously for fear of running out of them in a short time. Worst of all, some people even go bankrupted and be blackmailed to death!
Here are some tips that I use my pocket money: First, I invariably save one in four of them in the beginning, and spend the three in four buying what I really need. Also, I gave some money from the red envelopes to my father. He will use them to invest in the dock market. In this case, I often get double benifit from it! The bills are not burdensome for me at all! Last but not least, it is necessary that people learn how to manage their finance to the fullest since they are adolescents. Through the education, they won't become savages of money in the future!

subject: IW-0962
content:
I think the course, financial management, is very important. First, nowadays, more and more parents spoil their children, giving them whatever they want and how much they ask. It makes them not only develop a habit of wasting money without thoughts, but also makes them regard money as nothing. Second, under the unstable economic environment, learning how to use and manage their money is much more important. It can lead them to a better life in the future.
When I get my monthly pocket money, I always make a plan for it. It may contains how much for saving, for fun, and for others, totally three sections or so. By following this plan, I would beware of my spending, and interestingly, I also found that by that, I never ran out of my pocket money but always left some which could be use next month. I will continue using this tip, making good use of my money, and become a financial management master!

subject: IW-0962
content:
Financial management is an important course for everyone. However, most of us take that vital thing for granted. We shop whenever we like, or even spend a great deal of money without thinking twice. We view ourselves as poor people. In fact, the problem is that we don't know how to use money rather than earn more money. In my opinion, financial management is an indispensible course in life.
I get my allowances once a week. I always keep four hundred dollars in the envelope. Other one hundred dollars and five hundred dollars are for entertaining and dining expend. According to the tip, I can safe more than two thousand dollars per week! Money is to individuals what water is to fish. We definitely have to manage our finance wisely.

subject: IW-0962
content:
Education Ministry is managing to add financial management to junior high school curriculum. I think the thought is quite good because junior high school students are still too young to make the most of their pocket money. They may spend it going to Internet cafe or buying useless things. To prevent these incidents happen, teach them how to manage their allowances well is important.
I don't have much pocket money since I was little; hence, I cherish every dollar I save. If I want to buy lots of things at the same time, I will make a list and mark the price of each item. Then, I will spend money on the most important thing first. Besides, if I have save a lot of money, I will buy CDs or books I like. Sometimes I will save it in the bank.

subject: IW-0962
content: I think financial management is important. It was a comtemporary issue that we need to focus on. Why I think it is important? content:

content:

Usually, I just save it.
I think I am good at finacial management, though, it is significant that education minister put financial management into curriculumn of junior high school. Seeing the increasing rate at committing suicide caused by finacial problems and realizing that my friends don't care about money, I assume that finacial management is of great importance for students.

subject: IW-0962
content: It is reported that "financial management" might be a part of junior high school class. Although there are some people who support this proposal powerfully, I still think this is a question we should consider carefully. In my opinion, correct knowledge of money is important and basic in our daily life. However, maybe it isn't necessary enough to place financial concept in junior high school. Owing to my experience, I think these points could be a part of family edution. Since my childhood, my mother has taught me how to deal with my pocket money, my extra prize, or my money from "red envelop." I could make good use of my money, such as saving it in my account, donating it to charity, or just buying something I was interested in. In the conclusion, "financial management" might be a kind of living education or, in particular, a sort of family education.

subject: IW-0962
content: I think that taking financial management as a junior high school course is important. Because it is a good way to educate students how important money is and how to use money well in daily life. For example, if students know how important financial management is. They may become economical and realize that "saving a penny" is not easy, they will become economical and start to save money. Also, they may make plans carefully before they spend money, and don't waste money randomly. In my opinion, there are some good way to do the financial management. And I want to share my experiences with those students. Saving money regularly and Keeping accounts are both good way to manage your money. Saving money is a good way for planning for your future. And keeping accounts can help you try to control you cost when you know how you spend or waste your money. In conclusion, learning financial management is important and useful.
